profile.headline: Software Engineer at JustWorks
profile.summary: Hi, I am a software engineer employed at AWS Cerebo, an internal tools team used to track AWS profit margins. I've worked with various aspects of programming such as full stack development, system design, and AWS cloud development tools. I'm open to new opportunities.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Used docker containers to create a web app to display and filter test data from a MySQL server
  o Constructed using Node JS, Express, and Vue for full stack development
  o Used for internal testing to determine patterns in test data

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a web app to display live YouTube subscriber/view counts and Instagram Followers
  o Developed using Node JS, Express, and HTML/CSS for full stack develop
  o Automated the process of monitoring multiple social media accounts

positions.title: Product QA/Business Support Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a web app to compile and display data from motion tracking cameras
  o Used JavaScript and HTML to develop an application in a corporate team environment
  o Created to determine pathing in stores to allow for optimal store layout
• Performed quality assurance on the Samsung Enterprise Mobility Management Application
